metadata.title: Connect Devices
metadata.description: Share your fitness tracker or smartphone app with us.

options.title: TASK: Connect my device(s)
options.description:
Click on the connect button for your device.

The study team will collect activity, sleep, and health data from your wearable devices or smartphone apps. This data will be collected securely via RADAR-base.

devices.title: Fitbit
devices.description: By clicking Connect, you can read step-by-step instructions or watch a video to see how to share your Fitbit data. We are collecting physical activity, heart rate, and sleep data.

devices.title: Garmin
devices.description: By clicking Connect, you can read step-by-step instructions or watch a video to see how to share your Garmin data. We are collecting physical activity, heart rate, and sleep data.

devices.title: Oura Ring
devices.description: By clicking Connect, you can read step-by-step instructions or watch a video to see how to share your Oura Ring data. We are collecting physical activity, heart rate, temperature, and sleep data.

devices.title: RADAR Questionnaire App
devices.description: By clicking Connect, you can read step-by-step instructions or watch a video to see how to share your RADAR aRMT physical activity data.

studyInformation.title: Study Information
studyInformation.content: We understand that you may have questions about our research, what your involvement would be and much more. Please read carefully the Participant Information Sheet to find answers to these questions. If you have any questions about what you have read, please feel free to contact the team on .

eligibility.title: Who can take part in the Cycle Study?
eligibility.description: We can only accept people onto our study if they answer Yes to the following questions.

items.description: Do you live in the UK?
Have you been diagnosed with PMDD?
Do you own a wearable device (for example: Apple Watch with iPhone via HealthKit, Fitbit, Garmin, or Oura)?
Are you currently NOT using hormonal contraception?
Are you currently NOT pregnant and not breastfeeding?
Are you currently NOT under the support of an NHS crisis team for your mental health or have been in the last 6 months?

consent.title: Consent
consent.description:
Before you can take part in the Cycle Study, we need your consent to share data from your wearable devices or smartphone apps (such as activity, sleep, and heart-rate data), and to complete study questionnaires.
We also need you to create an account, using an email and password, so you can log back into the Cycle Study portal to manage your participation.
Your data will be managed by the Cycle Study research team at King's College London. You can find out more information about the way we use personal information in our [privacy policy](privacy).

requiredItems.description: I confirm that I have read and understood the information sheet dated 18/12/2025, Version One, for the above project and that I meet the eligibility criteria. I confirm I have had the opportunity to consider the information provided and to ask questions which have been answered to my satisfaction.

I consent voluntarily to be a participant in this project and understand that I can refuse to take part and can withdraw from the project at any time while taking part, without having to give a reason, and up until four weeks after taking part.

I understand my personal information will be processed for the purposes explained to me in the Information Sheet. I understand that such information will be handled under the terms of UK data protection law, including the UK GDPR and the Data Protection Act 2018.
I understand that my information may be subject to review by responsible individuals from the College for monitoring and audit purposes.

I understand that the study will collect all previously recorded data from my phone and wearable device such as sleep, heart rate, and physical activity and will continue to collect data via my phone and wearable device for the 8-10 week duration of the study. This information will be de-identified and will not include anything which could identify me by name, address, or date of birth.

I understand that I must not take part if I fall under the exclusion criteria as detailed in the information sheet. This includes receiving care from a crisis team for mental health currently, or in the past 6 months.
I understand that I will need to withdraw from the study if I indicate that I start receiving care from a crisis team whilst taking part.
I understand that the study involves sensitive questions, and covers questions on mental health, including about self-harm and suicidal ideation.

I understand that I can contact the study team via email about the research, or if I become distressed whilst taking part, and that the study email is monitored 9-5pm on weekdays and does not constitute crisis support.
I consent to the anonymised data being used for research publications, conferences, and other outputs such as blogs.
I consent to my email being used to receive a summary of the project findings.

consent.signatureDescription:
**Data Protection**

**The personal information we collect and use to conduct this research will be processed in accordance with data protection law as explained in the Participant Information Sheet and the Privacy Notice for Research Participants.**

By signing this consent form, I declare that I have provided accurate identity details (full name and electronic signature).
